content.title: New European R&D Hub Could Be a Game Changer for Yakult (TSE:2267)
content.summary: Earlier this month, Yakult Honsha established a European R&D unit in the Netherlands to serve as a global hub for food innovation, with the goal of meeting diverse consumer preferences and regulatory standards worldwide. This move signals Yakult’s commitment to accelerated product development and broader international reach through a coordinated global research framework. content.title: Yakult sets up European R&D unit in the Netherlands
content.summary: Yakult has established an R&D centre outside of Japan as the company aims to “create a global hub for food innovation that contributes to health and wellbeing”.
